programs.title: Caper Crew
programs.desc: It's Sparts Day at Woodspring Academy. The Joeys compete to win the Sparts trophy - which they suspect holds a clue to the Nug's whereabouts within.

programs.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo!
programs.desc: A very bad parking choice on Fred’s part leads the gang to an asteroid mining base in outer space where an alien virus appears to be infecting the crew one by one turning them into evil skull-headed aliens. The paranoid terrified gang must try to solve the mystery before the virus reaches them as well – if it hasn’t already.

programs.title: Transformers: Earthspark
programs.desc: The Maltos go on a search for the Embershards. When a Decepticon creates a new foe from a broken shard, the Malto's realize life in Witwicky is about to be chaotic.

programs.title: Gg: Spawn Squad
programs.sub_title: Flying Into Kirby Air Riders with Zac!
programs.desc: Zac and Gem take a first look at Kirby Air Riders! Exploring new game mechanics, strange control schemes and epic new courses, this episode has everything you need to know about the new racer!

programs.title: Spoooooky Game
programs.desc: In this Halloween episode, the gang's weekly board game night has been getting a little too competitive lately, so when Unikitty finds a spooky old board game that's clearly haunted, their desire to win gets turned upside down.

programs.title: Sparkle Matter Matters
programs.desc: When Unikitty learns that boring old Richard has never produced any happy Sparkle Matter ever, she cooks up a formula with Dr. Fox that will overload him with emotions! Now he's making so much Sparkle Matter it's threatening to destroy the kingdom! Can Unikitty help Richard find emotional balance before all is lost?
